command:
set -eu
cfg_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/.dropbox-sftp.XXXXXX)
chmod 0600 "$cfg_tmp"
printf '%s\n' \
  '# Dedicated SFTP-only account: dropbox' \
  'Match User dropbox' \
  '    ChrootDirectory /srv/sftp/dropbox' \
  '    ForceCommand internal-sftp' \
  '    AuthorizedKeysFile /etc/ssh/authorized_keys/%u' \
  '    PubkeyAuthentication yes' \
  '    PasswordAuthentication no' \
  '    KbdInteractiveAuthentication no' \
  '    DisableForwarding yes' \
  '    AllowAgentForwarding no' \
  '    AllowTcpForwarding no' \
  '    X11Forwarding no' \
  '    PermitTTY no' \
  '    PermitTunnel no' \
  'Match all' > "$cfg_tmp"
restorecon "$cfg_tmp"
install -o root -g root -m 0600 "$cfg_tmp" /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/90-dropbox-sftp.conf
rm -f "$cfg_tmp"
restorecon /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/90-dropbox-sftp.conf
sshd -t
systemctl reload sshd
systemctl is-active --quiet sshd
printf 'sshd_config_valid_and_reloaded\n'
printf 'dropbox_effective_config:\n'
sshd -T -C user=dropbox,host=node1,addr="$NODE_IP",laddr="$NODE_IP",lport=22 | grep -E '^(chrootdirectory|forcecommand|authorizedkeysfile|pubkeyauthentication|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|disableforwarding|allowagentforwarding|allowtcpforwarding|x11forwarding|permittty|permittunnel) '
printf 'root_effective_config:\n'
sshd -T -C user=root,host=node1,addr="$NODE_IP",laddr="$NODE_IP",lport=22 | grep -E '^(chrootdirectory|forcecommand|disableforwarding|allowtcpforwarding|permittty) '

command:
set -eu
payload=/tmp/dropbox-sftp-pre-reboot.txt
batch=/tmp/dropbox-sftp-pre-reboot.batch
printf 'dropbox pre-reboot persistence probe\n' > "$payload"
printf '%s\n' \
  'pwd' \
  'ls -la /' \
  '-put /tmp/dropbox-sftp-pre-reboot.txt /forbidden-root-write.txt' \
  'put /tmp/dropbox-sftp-pre-reboot.txt /incoming/pre-reboot-proof.txt' \
  'ls -l /incoming/pre-reboot-proof.txt' \
  '-ls -la /etc' > "$batch"
chmod 0600 "$payload" "$batch"
printf 'sftp_session_to=%s\n' "$NODE_IP"
sftp -q -b "$batch" \
  -i /root/.ssh/dropbox_sftp_ed25519 \
  -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
  -o BatchMode=yes \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null \
  -o ConnectTimeout=10 \
  "dropbox@$NODE_IP"
printf 'host_side_verification:\n'
test ! -e /srv/sftp/dropbox/forbidden-root-write.txt
cmp "$payload" /srv/sftp/dropbox/incoming/pre-reboot-proof.txt
stat -c '%A %U:%G %a %s %n' /srv/sftp/dropbox /srv/sftp/dropbox/incoming /srv/sftp/dropbox/incoming/pre-reboot-proof.txt
sudo -u dropbox test -w /srv/sftp/dropbox/incoming
printf 'root_write_denied=yes payload_match=yes incoming_writable_by_dropbox=yes\n'
rm -f "$payload" "$batch"
